svg.desc: Hoye peeling ddd multiplet (500 MHz) · 5-timepoint kinetics stack · GUM qNMR metrology (synthetic forward-model showcase)
svg.text: Analytical 1D NMR: Recursive J-Coupling Tree, Arrayed Kinetics Stack & GUM qNMR
Hoye peeling ddd multiplet (500 MHz) · 5-timepoint kinetics stack · GUM qNMR metrology (synthetic forward-model showcase)
A. Recursive Hoye J-Tree Splitting Diagram (ddd)
1H NMR (500 MHz, CDCl3) delta 5.82 (ddd, J = 14.4, 8.4, 3.2 Hz, 1H).
B. Tilted Reaction Kinetics 1D Overlay Stack (t = 0..120 min)
Reactant OCH2 (4.22 ppm) -> Product HOCH2 (3.68 ppm)
C. Internal-Standard qNMR Integral Trace & Purity
Analyte 4.12 ppm (2.00 H) · DMS Std 3.00 ppm (6.00 H)
